description: One product's pool of trial keys: how many stay ready, and the Grove Model Group they add to the team's catalog.

fields.description: How many ready keys Central keeps minted for this product's free trials; the 5-minute job refills it. 0 keeps it off: the product's trial servers boot without a key.

fields.description: A Grove Model Group in the trial geography, minted onto this product's keys on top of Central Trial's own catalog. Blank: the team's catalog alone. Applies to keys minted after; a wrong name fails the mint, logged.
